title: Lint Buffer (Unsaved)
summary: Lints the current editor buffer's in-memory content, including unsaved edits, without writing it to disk first
intro: Read this when you want lint findings for edits you have not saved yet. The IDE lints the in-memory editor buffer directly, without writing it to disk first; the command line lints saved files.

surfaces.caption: Lint Buffer (Unsaved)
steps: Edit a unit without saving it
Open the About and Status window (drag-lint > About)
Click Lint Buffer (Unsaved); findings for the in-memory content are shown
